rationale: Smallest real dataset with true ground-truth claim-verification labels and evidence; binary SUPPORT/CONTRADICT gives direct VCR; no LLM judge, no subjective grading; deterministic offline run in seconds; supports a real cheap-vs-expensive budget axis without any model API.

rejected_for_first_run.HaluEval: needs answer generator (LLM) for the cheap pass
rejected_for_first_run.TruthfulQA: generative QA item; first pass must avoid generation
rejected_for_first_run.SciClaimEval2026: cross-modal; adds complexity, reserved as future branch

fallback: FEVER (same task shape, 185445 claims) if SciFact signal degenerate; not needed.
binary_vcr_justification: label SUPPORT->1, CONTRADICT->0, NOINFO dropped; VCR = correct_final_labels / total_items, exact binary scoring against gold annotations.
